back.es: here (adverb of place, especially with verbs of motion, as in 'come here')
back.example: Come here, I want to show you something.

note: The hint correctly rules out aquí, but aquí is also everyday across much of Latin America, especially Mexico, so a softer wording such as "the word favored in Latin America, not aquí" would avoid suggesting aquí is only used in Spain.
